project_name: AI Receipt Audit System — R&D Project
description: An R&D project developing an AI-powered system to audit expense receipts for semantic policy compliance. The project has three sequential phases.

phases.name: Phase 1: Infrastructure Setup
phases.description: Setting up development environment, cloud accounts, APIs, hardware, and tooling.

phases.name: Phase 2: Experimentation
phases.description: Running AI model experiments, data collection, annotation, and iterative development.

phases.name: Phase 3: Evaluation & Documentation
phases.description: Final testing, writing the research paper, and preparing deliverables.
